title: A managed form: arrange fields and rows while preserving data
goal: Create an explicit document form in a copy, display the header and Работы, and verify input usability without changing older values.

prerequisites.text: 1c-enterprise.a 4; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.

sections.title: A form supports a workflow
paragraphs: Place customer, service and duration in input order. Labels must state units; required fields should be identifiable without color alone. Save must communicate its outcome. A starter form does not need dozens of buttons: tie every action to an operator task and a verifiable state.

A form is a window for viewing/editing an object, not an independent database. An automatic form is derived from metadata; an explicit managed form lets the developer select layout and elements. An element must bind to Объект data: a decorative text field without a data path does not persist a document attribute.

sections.title: Form elements bind to object data
paragraphs: This is a form structure, not BSL; select bindings in the form editor.

  Объект.Услуга

  Объект.Работы
code.output: Actual fields/rows are visible and standard writing persists them.

sections.title: A form element differs from a data attribute
paragraphs: An input displays an attribute but does not itself create persistent storage. An unbound control can lose entered values. Trace control → formattribute → object. Relabeling must preserve links to stored data. Appearance is not a substitute for choosing the business data type.

Работы already exists in the previous lesson’s copy. Add a document form under Forms, select header fields and the table in the wizard, and assign the main object form. If an existing custom form is present, inspect and preserve it first; create a separately named teaching form in the copy instead of overwriting someone else’s development.

sections.title: An error should guide correction
paragraphs: For negative minutes, name the field and allowed range while preserving other inputs. Do not clear the form or create a new document just to retry. A keyboard user must locate the error and return to Save. A rejected command must not show a false success message.

Place required fields before the optional comment, with rows below. Clear ordering reduces omissions but does not replace validation. Keep required fields visible and do not enable privileged mode. This lesson uses standard save commands; custom commands and client/server handlers belong to the programming course.

sections.title: A caption without a data path
paragraphs: Check the object field and reread, not appearance alone.

code.output: The caption does not establish that the document stores 30.

sections.title: Usability is checked through actions
paragraphs: Use Tab, select a reference, enter duration, save and reopen without a mouse. Check a long service name and narrow window. A responsive Nexus page does not prove the 1C desktop client works on a phone: record the actual client and device. Screenshots supplement the workflow protocol rather than replacing execution.

Test an older document with empty new rows and the newer 20/10 document. Reopen, compare and reread. Rearranging elements alone must not change number, date, references or duration. Edits in an open form remain a draft until a save command: distinguish discarding unsaved changes from Save and close.

sections.title: Check your explanation
paragraphs: A caption is mistaken for a stored attribute. Inspect its data path and reread the actual object field.
Required fields are hidden for visual simplicity. Keep them visible and verify input order.
A new form overwrites the only working base. Use a separate copy and preserve the source form/data.

steps.where: Copy Enterprise after the preceding lesson

steps.action: Choose Document form named УчебнаяФормаЗаявки. Select Клиент, Услуга, ДлительностьМинут, Статус, Комментарий and Работы with its fields. Verify the main attribute Объект.
steps.why: The wizard binds elements to object data.
steps.expected: A separate managed form has data-bound elements.
steps.troubleshooting: If your attempt already created this name, inspect and reuse it instead of duplicating.

steps.title: Arrange and assign
steps.where: Form editor → Elements; document properties → Main forms
steps.action: Place required fields above the comment and Работы below the header. Keep standard commands. Assign УчебнаяФормаЗаявки as main object form only in this copy.
steps.why: Order input while preserving standard writing.
steps.expected: Required fields and commands are present.
steps.troubleshooting: Do not replace an existing developed form in your source base.

steps.title: Apply and open
steps.action: Review changes, update the copy and open your newer control document. Check header, Работы and standard commands.
steps.expected: Assigned form opens with persisted rows.
steps.troubleshooting: If another form opens, inspect the main-form assignment and previously open window.
steps.before: Required fields and commands are present.

steps.title: Test input and preservation
steps.action: Traverse fields with Tab. Change only the newer document comment to Форма A5 проверена, save and reopen. Compare header/rows. Open the older document without edits and compare its recorded controls.
steps.why: Usability and preservation require separate observations.
steps.expected: New comment persists; earlier fields and rows remain intact.
steps.troubleshooting: Do not infer writing from appearance; reread the document.
steps.before: Assigned form opens with persisted rows.

criteria: Identify Объект data and presentation elements.
Header/rows persist and the older document remains intact.
Concrete observations/corrections recorded without claiming every-device accessibility.
Actual infobase/version, own synthetic codes and numbers, before/after field observations.
Saved source and outcome; any missing or untested behavior explicitly recorded.
Use the second worked case only in an own copy or unsaved draft. Preserve the accepted record and explain the discrepancy.
